comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html:
This is a debug tool, it’s meant for developers to get a quick understanding of what a bot is doing, not squint at their screen trying to figure out what a bot is doing. And it’s definitely not meant to be run while actually playing the game.

Feel free to fork the mod if you feel that you can do it better, it’s open source and MIT licensed

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html: I’m just using BepInEx’s key handling stuff, so it would be whatever it supports. Ctrl should be supported as a modifier, so I don’t see why it wouldn’t work.

comments.author: GentlemenSausage
comments.body_html: What is the exact format for setting the keyboard shortcut ? Could you give an example?

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html: You hit F12, expand BotDebug, click the button beside the option you want to rebind, and press the keys you want to use

comments.author: CorvusMaege
comments.body_html: Hi Drakia! I’m seeing some bots not detected by BotDebug.

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html: BotDebug uses the games AllPlayers list, if that list is missing bots there’s not much I can do about it. You can also check the F12 menu settings to verify that your range for BotDebug isn’t lower than the bot distance from you
